objection: A hand-supplied return detector can control actions even if public feedback did not select anything useful. Correctly guessing B to be stocked does not establish recognition of its identity.
resolution: Freeze outcome-blind tests on identical public paths against disabled credit, feedback re-pairing, and a fixed strict-return detector. Separate physical selector changes, behavioral differences, stock correctness and public certificates. Erase only the second memory and exchange its selected field before issuing a read from the separate actuator. Measure autonomous lifetime on a disjoint renamed fold.
additional_advisor: Fable 5.2 returned its weekly account limit. The independent Astra Max review covered the initial proposal and verified the bound revised design before any fresh gameplay.
referee: Scientific referee pending, separate from prospective review.
